name: Multi-View Feature Extraction Pipeline
definition: A feature extraction pipeline that aggregates geometry-aware features from multiple input views by combining multi-view transformer features, monocular depth priors, and cost-volume matching evidence, outputting a unified low-resolution feature tensor.
summary: The Multi-View Feature Extraction Pipeline aggregates geometry-aware features from multiple views into a unified low-resolution tensor by combining transformer features, monocular depth priors, and cost-volume matching.
